prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of MAKARA. The complete Ganapati Sthapati source version of the Makara, a living fish-bodied elephant-trunked lion-footed monkey-eyed pig-eared peacock-tailed guardian.
ANATOMY: ONE living hybrid creature, exactly ONE head, TWO monkey-like forward-facing intelligent eyes with rounded brow sockets, TWO clearly PIG ears folded into pointed porcine ear flaps, ONE long ELEPHANT TRUNK raised and curled toward viewer, a large scaly FISH BODY, FOUR sturdy limbs ending in unmistakable LION FEET with paw pads and natural toes, and ONE PEACOCK TAIL with feather eyespots fully unfurled at its rear. All SIX source components large and distinct: fish body, elephant trunk, lion feet, monkey eyes, pig ears, peacock tail. No crocodile jaw, elephant fan ears, fish tail fin replacing peacock, horns, tusks, wings or armour. [makara-c15]
MOMENT: Stride forward from a dark sacred gateway, one lion forepaw planted heavily in the foreground and the other lifted, trunk raised toward the viewer, intelligent eyes intent and protective, peacock feather tail sweeps in one living fan behind. Never a statue or ornamental carving.
POWER: No documented supernatural visual power. Sacred guardian presence comes from the striking complete hybrid anatomy and decisive protective movement; a few dust grains only from the paws meeting stone. No energy streams, water spell or fire. [makara-c03, makara-c15]
SCALE & CAMERA: Low-angle close three-quarter composition with entire head/trunk/ears/eyes large in upper foreground, one LION PAW huge at bottom, fish scales readable along flank, full peacock tail clear behind to one side. All required animal components visible, no tiny tail cut off.
LIGHT & WEATHER: One warm low sunlight from outside the doorway lights wet-dark fish scales, matte paw fur and iridescent peacock feathers; deep temple shadow behind, no flame lantern or glow.
SURFACE: Tactile natural fur, fish/serpent scales, hoof, feathers or stone as specified; premium traditional painterly brushwork, never glossy plastic or a toy.
SETTING: At the threshold of an ancient temple gateway which Makara protects; architecture minimal and dark, creature dominates. [makara-c03]
MOOD: overwhelming and imposing sacred presence; respectful, benevolent when source says so, energetic and majestic, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: one square original illustration; no text, labels, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra limbs, heads, tails or digits beyond exact counts above; no nudity or gore; no design from a film, game, anime or comic; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, floating runes or unsupported supernatural effects. Identifying anatomical components all readable at thumbnail size.
